set.body:
Owner decision required (SD5): new public vocabulary.

Proposal
- A referent mention may be a visual detection or track, a dialogue mention, or a recall mention,
  extending the text-only MentionIdentity layer in document/coreference.scala.
- IdentityLink is born unforgeable (rule 8, Cartesian-product test: validity depends on relation
  and provenance). It carries a typed basis with a licence class:
  sufficient alone (one continuous track; named or addressed while the referent is present) vs
  contributory only (appearance match, timestamp proximity, compatible description).
- Ambiguity keeps alternatives (MentionIdentity.Open semantics); SameAs stays a hypothesis until
  a licensed basis resolves it.
- A Speech-to-NarratedWorld promotion status (Inferred, premises cited) is decided in the same ADR
  so S4 adds no unreviewed vocabulary.

Rejected alternative to record: an LLM assigning global entity ids per question.
Acceptance: ADR accepted by the owner; courts plan for apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror from outside
the defining package.
set.title: [evidence-binding S2] ADR: cross-modal referent mentions and licensed identity links
